releaseNotes: Expands the curated verse-specific faith-response library from 139 to 150 unique Scripture references. Eleven new single-verse entries add distinct prayers, declarations, affirmations, confessions and contextual inspirations for deliverance, burdens, gratitude, God's presence in adversity, peacemaking, repentance, resurrection hope, assurance in Christ, freedom, gracious speech and patient listening. The coverage audit now requires at least 150 unique references and validates each reference and all five response fields against the offline KJV. Refreshes the offline cache.
